mapper.sql: p.id AS id, p.app_id AS appId, a.name AS appName, a.repo_branch AS repoBranch, p.name AS name, p.status AS status, p.version AS version, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dev_pipeline_stage s WHERE s.pipeline_id = p.id AND s.version = p.version AND s.is_deleted = 0) AS stageCount, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime
FROM dev_pipeline p LEFT JOIN dev_app a ON a.id = p.app_id AND a.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT
p.is_deleted = 0
AND p.app_id IN
#{appId}
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.name}, '%')
AND p.status = #{query.status}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dev_run r WHERE r.pipeline_id = p.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status IN
#{runStatus} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dev_run r WHERE r.pipeline_id = p.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status IN (1, 2))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dev_run r WHERE r.pipeline_id = p.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 5 AND r.create_time >= CURDATE())
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dev_run r WHERE r.pipeline_id = p.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 3 AND r.block_reason IN (1, 2))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dev_run r JOIN dev_run_stage rs ON rs.run_id = r.id AND rs.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.pipeline_id = p.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND rs.stage_type = 7 AND rs.status IN (1, 2, 5))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dev_run r WHERE r.pipeline_id = p.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 8)
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.id DESC
